name: ref2game
description: Turn a visual reference into a polished, playable 2D game slice with generated art, deterministic simulation, measured fidelity, animation, effects and QA.

interface.longDescription: Build a polished playable 2D game slice from a screenshot, video, concept, key art or mood reference. The workflow studies the reference, creates a style bible and measured match state, generates art, builds deterministic simulation and scene code, adds rigs/effects/game feel, and validates the result with automated QA and critics.
defaultPrompt: Turn this reference into a playable 2D game slice.
Build a 2D level from this gameplay video.
Match this concept art as a playable scene.
